🤖 Who we are

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

🚀 What keeps us up at night

We’re building a medical agent that works — reliably, safely, and at scale.

You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. Our mission is to build the most accurate and reliable medical agent in the world, while delivering an outstanding conversational experience. Things we’re working on:

  • 💬 Deliver the most memorable chatting experience — You’ll work on making Mo the obvious choice when it comes to asking a health question. It means having a world-class snappy and delightful chatting experience, blazing fast time to answer, and rich content shared.

  • 🧱 Integrate Mo with Alan services and our healthcare system — You’ll work on integrating Mo with our other services (digital chat with HP, map of physical location of HPs, tailored prevention programs, …) to help members get from words to actions.

  • ➕ Extend our architecture to support the next chapters of Mo — You’ll work on our architecture, and agentic framework, to support Mo’s next needs (get more context, use new skills, be accessible in other countries we operate in)

If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. If you’re curious, here is a paper we published recently.

🎯 Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

  • You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, multi-agent architectures, and human-in-the-loop learning — and see your work deployed in production, helping real people.

  • You’ll implement new capabilities for Mo, working across engineering, data, and medical expertise

  • You'll have deep product ownership over the use cases supported in Mo, making sure we actually help our members get and stay better.

  • You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality

  • You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring, shaping our interview loops, etc.).

You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you:

  • Applied background in software engineering and systems architecture

  • Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus.

  • Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful

  • Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working

  • Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

  • Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

  • Fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

  • Ex-founders are typically great fit in our team

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🤘 How we do it ?

We benefit from Alan’s platform, infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our Shareholder Letters are worth a read.

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

How we work: our Leadership Principles

  • Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else.

  • Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots: everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radical Transparency — All information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

  • Always Growing — Direct, positive, and caring feedback, combined with self-growth ownership.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. You. Better. With Alan.

We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system.

By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives.

We partner with 35K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached 770M+ in ARR.

Our team of 700 people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, and Canada 🇨🇦.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

You would join the team in charge of building smart products offering the most delightful and scalable Customer Service to 1M+ members.


We have developed a team of AI agents that brings immediate and personalized answers to about 50% of member's questions.


And when it is not enough, we seamlessly transfer the question to our care experts team. We build the cockpit for that handoff and the tooling for the humans who take over. It lets a care expert steer, correct, and supercharge the AI: routing requests, surfacing the right context at the right moment and drafting replies. The expert stays in command; the AI does the heavy lifting.

  • Direct Impact: Your decisions affect Alan’s scaling, growth, profitability and ability to provide delightful experience to members when they need it the most.

  • Full-stack experience (backend and frontend)

  • You love turning complex problems into elegant solutions

  • Healthcare technology excites you

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

La santé n'attend pas.

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu'il faille 6 mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu'on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d'affaires multiplié par 7 en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de CA et + 1 M de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de CA d’ici 2030.

Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.

⭐️ La Finance chez Alan ⭐️

La Finance chez Alan, c’est l’équipe qui bâtit le socle financier permettant de piloter une assurance santé digitale en pleine croissance, sur des marchés où presque tout reste à construire.

Le cœur de nos responsabilités : produire une information financière fiable pour chacune de nos entités, tenir des comptes toujours prêts pour la clôture, et donner à l’entreprise les chiffres sur lesquels elle peut s’appuyer pour décider. Au quotidien, cela signifie tenir la comptabilité, piloter les clôtures, coordonner les cabinets externes, suivre la trésorerie et pousser l’automatisation dans un contexte multi-pays et multi-devises.

Nous réunissons une diversité de profils :

  • Des profils qui structurent : définition du modèle de reporting, des normes et des processus financiers,

  • Des profils qui délivrent : une production comptable et un reporting d’excellence au quotidien, tout en améliorant en continu ce que nous faisons.

Nous recherchons des membres d’équipe prêts à instaurer des standards financiers de classe mondiale sur des marchés qui les méritent, et à en faire un véritable avantage.

⭐️ Le rôle de Directeur Financier ⭐️

Nous recherchons un(e) responsable financier(ère) expérimenté(e) et opérationnel(le) pour porter l’ensemble de la fonction finance de nos activités en Afrique de l’Ouest.

Vous serez le point unique de responsabilité sur la façon dont ce périmètre est piloté et reporté. Basé(e) à Dakar, vous ferez le lien entre les équipes locales, les cabinets externes et la maison-mère. En détail, vos missions comprendront :

  • Piloter le reporting de l’ensemble du périmètre : produire chaque mois le compte de résultat, le bilan et la situation de trésorerie de chaque entité et les intégrer proprement dans le reporting mensuel global.

  • Coordonner les comptables et les cabinets : animer une équipe de comptables et la relation avec les cabinets d’expertise-comptable externes de chaque entité — fixer le calendrier de clôture, revoir leurs livrables et tenir le niveau de qualité.

  • Piloter la clôture et les contrôles : assurer une clôture mensuelle fiable sur l’ensemble des entités et des devises (FCFA et USD), porter les rapprochements et mettre en place les contrôles nécessaires à mesure que l’activité se rapproche de comptes prêts pour l’audit.

  • Assurer le lien avec la maison-mère : être l’interlocuteur(rice) finance du groupe — traduire les réalités locales en standards de reporting, répondre aux demandes de données et soutenir la consolidation.

  • Améliorer, automatiser et faire grandir l’équipe : challenger et fluidifier les processus financiers pour réduire le travail manuel et accélérer le reporting, et participer au recrutement, à l’onboarding et à la montée en compétences de l’équipe finance locale.

Vous travaillerez en grande autonomie, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes centrales Finance, Data et Trésorerie.

⭐️ Une opportunité unique de participer à quelque chose d'historique ⭐️

En tant que membre de l'équipe Alan, vous serez aux avant-postes d'une véritable révolution de la santé en Afrique de l'Ouest. Vous contribuerez à bâtir la colonne vertébrale opérationnelle d'une entreprise passant de 30 000 à des centaines de milliers de membres, de deux pays à un continent entier.

Vous vivrez l'énergie d'une startup rapide, portée par ses fondateurs et en pleine croissance. Ce n'est pas un poste d'opérations ordinaire : vous opérerez sur un marché où tout est à construire, et où votre travail aura un impact direct et visible sur la vie des gens.

⭐️ Vous êtes peut-être la bonne personne si… ⭐️

  • Vous avez plus de 6 ans d’expérience en comptabilité/finance, avec une réelle responsabilité dans une clôture multi-entités.

  • Vous maîtrisez les normes SYSCOHADA / OHADA et la fiscalité locale (TVA, IS/BIC).

  • Vous avez fait vos preuves dans le management de comptables et de cabinets externes, la définition de standards et la tenue d’un calendrier de production, vous faites fonctionner un dispositif financier distribué dans les délais.

  • Vous êtes rigoureux(se), autonome, proactif(ve) et orienté(e) solution.

  • Vous êtes un(e) excellent(e) communicant(e), à l’aise pour faire le pont entre des équipes locales et des interlocuteurs internationaux.

  • Vous êtes parfaitement à l’aise en français et en anglais (langue de travail du groupe).

C’est encore mieux si vous avez :

  • Une expérience en assurance santé, en mutuelle (IPM/mutuelle) ou dans un environnement de gestion pour compte de tiers (TPA).

  • Une bonne connaissance de l’environnement réglementaire au Sénégal ou en Côte d’Ivoire ; une expérience de consolidation (US GAAP ou IFRS/normes françaises) est un plus.

  • Des compétences en data et en automatisation pour fiabiliser et accélérer le reporting.

🎁 Avantages

  • Type de contrat : CDI.

  • Sur site, dans nos bureaux de Dakar, en collaboration étroite avec une équipe locale passionnée.

  • Tous les outils nécessaires pour donner le meilleur de vous-même.

  • Une assurance santé complète via Alan pour vous et votre famille.

  • Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation : une politique flexible, des budgets pour les livres et les conférences.

🎯 Note importante : nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles.

Si cette opportunité vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. Toutes les personnes, y compris celles issues de groupes sous-représentés, devraient se sentir libres de postuler : soit on réussit, soit on apprend. Rappelez-vous, ceci est un guide, pas une liste exhaustive. #LI-DNP

🤖 Who we are

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

 

🚀 Why we need you

Mo’s scope is expanding fast: inside Alan (a new Clinic, new capabilities), across the countries we operate in, and at the interfaces with many other Alan experiences. To get this expansion right, and to keep ownership distributed within the team, we’re looking for a Product Builder to take on a real share of that complexity and ambiguity.

You’ll own end-to-end one slice of Mo’s product scope. Depending on your profile, it could be:

  • 🩺 Mo for reactive care. Build all the integrations between Mo, our Clinic and the healthcare system, and shape how our medical team interacts with members in and through Mo.

  • 🛡️ Mo for insurance. Make Mo the main interface between members and Alan, building on our Support AI agents, across channels and countries.

  • 🌍 Mo global. Adapt Mo to new countries and find the right operating model for each (medical reviews, safety, local features).

  • ➕ Mo as a platform. Make Mo the companion other teams build upon, so our domain experts can ship their own experiences through it.

🎯 Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for Product Builders with around 5+ years of experience who want to build state-of-the-art AI products and apply them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

  • You’ll own a product area end-to-end: problem framing, vision, prioritisation, shipping, and measuring whether we actually help members get and stay better.

  • You’ll work daily with engineers, ML engineers, data, and doctors, at the frontier of LLMs and agentic systems, and see your work in production with real people.

  • You’ll navigate ambiguity and many stakeholders across Alan, and turn it into clear decisions and a focused roadmap.

  • You’ll be hands-on: prototyping, digging into data, reading conversations and evals, getting into the technical details with the team.

  • You’ll contribute to our product culture and help build the team (hiring, interview loops, etc.).

You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you:

  • Experience building and shipping a live AI/LLM product

  • Very hands-on, comfortable with technical and data topics (SQL, prototyping, understanding how an LLM system behaves and fails)

  • Interest or experience in one or several medical or prevention themes

  • Product-minded and outcome-driven: you care about impact, not output

  • Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working

  • Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

  • Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

  • Fluent in English

  • Ex-engineers and ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus

 

🤘 How we do it ?

We benefit from Alan’s platform, infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our Shareholder Letters are worth a read.

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

 

How we work: our Leadership Principles

  • Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else.

  • Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots: everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radical Transparency — All information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

  • Always Growing — Direct, positive, and caring feedback, combined with self-growth ownership.

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

 

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!
